summary: Iteration 14 backend validation of the REGIME-AWARE confluence-scored engine (backend/edge.py). All 6 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_regime_engine_lifecycle.py PASSED end-to-end against the live preview backend + live MetaApi/MT5 demo account. Key results: (1) GET /api/trades/scan-status now returns the new schema per instrument: tradeable, regime (momentum|reversion|chop), score, adx, win_prob, expected_r, reason. Live snapshot: XAUUSD tradeable=true regime=momentum score=80 side=SELL ADX=33 wp=0.46 er=+0.83R reason='Momentum SELL · confluence 80/100 · 45% win, +0.83R at 3.0:1, ADX 33, hold ~1h 30m'; BTCUSD tradeable=false regime=chop ADX=25 reason='Unclear regime (ADX 25, VR 0.78) — no edge, standing aside'; Volatility 100 Index tradeable=false regime=reversion reason='Mean-reversion regime but RSI 52 isn\u2019t stretched — no fade setup'. All win_probs are honest (0.33\u20130.80 range, no 0.9+ anywhere); chop/low-score instruments are tradeable=false; tradeable items satisfy score>=62 and expected_r>0 invariants. (2) POST /api/trades/propose on tradeable XAUUSD returned the complete new schema: regime='momentum', score=80, side='SELL', rr=3.0, lot=0.8, win_prob=0.515, expected_r=+1.06R, stop_loss=4139.55, take_profit=4100.47, est_risk_usd=$781.60, est_reward_usd=$2344.80, with reasons that include 'Momentum regime: ADX 33, price below EMA20/50', MACD/+DI/-DI confluence lines, and the Monte-Carlo 'Simulation: 51% win odds, +1.06R expected...' plus the 20%-cap trim note. (3) RISK CAP VERIFIED: est_risk_usd=$781.60 on equity $3955.19 = 19.76% \u2264 20%. lot was trimmed from the base confidence-sized ladder (0.8 < 2) and the trim is explicitly cited in reasons ('Lot trimmed to 0.8 so this trade risks \u2264 20% of your $3955.19 equity'). (4) FULL LIFECYCLE PASSED (the key test): tradeable proposal -> POST /approve places real market order on MetaApi -> GET /positions lists the new open position -> GET /positions AGAIN (refetch) shows it still present (DB-backed persistence confirmed) -> POST /positions/{id}/close removes it -> /positions returns empty -> /trades/log shows status='closed'. (5) ADAPTIVE LEARNING RECORDS THE OUTCOME: /api/trades/edge overall.n went 13 -> 15 across two lifecycle executions, win_rate 0.0 -> 0.067, expectancy_r -0.081 -> -0.072, new setups[] entries exist including 'SELL XAUUSD' with realized expectancy_r. (6) NO REGRESSIONS: /api/trades/account returns {available:true, is_demo:true, equity:3981.20, growth:{start_balance, target_balance:19922.38, growth_pct:0.0, goal_reached:false}}. /api/market/candles?symbol=XAUUSD&timeframe=15m&limit=200 returned 200 candles in <2s. Cleanup: both lifecycle positions closed, test proposals rejected, no leftover open positions, no leftover pending proposals.

minor.issue: Only 3 instruments appear in scan-status right now (XAUUSD, BTCUSD, Volatility 100 Index). The spec and iteration-13 tests referenced XAUUSD and Volatility 10/25/50/75/100 Index. Other Volatility symbols are gated by _active_mt5_symbols()/strategies. Not a bug for THIS iteration \u2014 the engine behaves correctly on the symbols it does scan \u2014 but a 24/7 synthetic lifecycle fallback was unavailable this run, so XAUUSD was used for the lifecycle (worked fine).
25/25 LIMIT_ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PER_USER still intermittently drops the broker socket. Code handles with warm cache + retries; no test instability observed this run.

critical_code_review_comments: edge.py regime detection (ADX + VR) + confluence scorer is wired end-to-end to the UI surface: scan-status returns the full {regime, score, adx, win_prob, expected_r} tuple and the reason strings are human-readable and specific per regime ('Momentum SELL \u00b7 confluence 80/100 ...', 'Unclear regime (ADX 25, VR 0.78) \u2014 no edge, standing aside', 'Mean-reversion regime but RSI 52 isn\u2019t stretched \u2014 no fade setup'). This is a big UX win over the old flat-confidence readout.

MIN_SCORE=62 gate is enforced for tradeability on both /scan-status and /propose; XAUUSD at score=80 produced a tradeable proposal while BTCUSD (chop, ADX 25 but VR 0.78) and Vol 100 (reversion without stretched RSI) were correctly held off. Chop filter works.
Honest-odds pipeline from iteration 13 still clean: all observed win_probs in [0.46, 0.52] under calibration \u2014 no absurd 0.9+ values anywhere.

Risk cap at 20% equity is exactly enforced with a human-readable note in reasons[]. XAUUSD SELL came out at 19.76% of equity after lot-trimming to 0.8 (confidence-sized ladder would have exceeded cap).
DB-backed /positions persistence is confirmed by the two sequential GETs across the lifecycle test \u2014 the simulated refresh case the main-agent asked for passes.

Adaptive learning loop is self-reinforcing and verified live: approve \u2192 position \u2192 close now reliably increments /api/trades/edge overall.n and inserts a 'SIDE SYMBOL' setup entry with a realized R-multiple.

Nit (carried from iter-13 and still open): /api/trades/edge historical backfill for pre-feature closed trades still absent \u2014 only trades closed since learning.record_outcome shipped are counted. Not blocking.

Nit: HTTP error granularity on /propose still collapses to 400 for all non-ok cases ('MT5 unavailable' vs 'confidence too low' vs 'symbol not in active instruments'). A stable error_code field in the JSON body would help the frontend route the message correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 pytest cases passed, including full propose->approve->positions(x2 refetch)->close->edge.n increment loop against live MetaApi/MT5 demo)

seed_data_creation: Opened + closed 2 demo trades during lifecycle tests (XAUUSD SELL both times). /api/trades/edge went from n=13 to n=15 as a direct result. Both positions reconciled to closed, /positions returns [] at test end. Two test proposals (one on XAUUSD, one on the propose-schema test) were rejected cleanly \u2014 no pending proposals left behind. No TEST_ strategies created this run (XAUUSD lifecycle did not require a dummy strategy).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_regime_engine_lifecycle.py -v -s. All 6 tests auto-adapt to live market state: if NO instrument is tradeable at run time, propose-schema and full-lifecycle tests SKIP (not fail). Each successful lifecycle run adds +1 to /api/trades/edge overall.n and may add a new setups[] entry \u2014 that is the acceptance criterion. Lifecycle currently uses XAUUSD because that is the only tradeable item in /scan-status right now; the test will prefer Volatility indices if any appear tradeable. Open issues carried from iter-13 (both minor): /api/trades/edge has no historical backfill for pre-feature closes; propose error granularity could use an error_code field. No critical issues.
rca of the issue: No bugs blocking the feature. The entire propose \u2192 approve \u2192 persist \u2192 close \u2192 learn pipeline works on the live MetaApi demo account with the new regime-aware engine. XAUUSD proposal at score=80 (momentum regime, ADX 33) placed successfully on MetaApi, persisted across a refetch, closed on demand, and the realized outcome was recorded by learning.record_outcome (edge.n went 13\u219215 across two runs with correct per-setup aggregation).
